title: Fast rising music star, Tommy Stoner is a name worth mentioning in the music scene
htmlContent:
An emerging figure in today's music scene, Tommy Stoner, is a talented singer and songwriter based in America. Having taken his time to learn about his craft, the talented artist does not disappoint in his recent track "Real With Me."

In his recent track, "Real With Me," Tommy Stoner talks about facing your fears, talking your relationship through, not shutting down, blocking your partner out, or BLOCKING the person on your phone. With an infectious sound and swagger-filled lyrics, Tommy passes an important message to his fans to learn from.
